## Statement

[View PDF](pdf/main.pdf) · [Download LaTeX source](latex/main.tex) -- covers both the secret-seed and public-seed variants (see also [c/0004](/c/0004/))

### Setting

Fix nonempty finite sets $\mathcal{K}$ (seeds), $\mathcal{D}$ (inputs), $\mathcal{R}$ (outputs), and write $K := |\mathcal{K}|$, $D := |\mathcal{D}|$, $R := |\mathcal{R}|$. Let $\mathsf{Fun}(\mathcal{K}\times\mathcal{D},\mathcal{R})$ be the set of all functions $\mathcal{K}\times\mathcal{D}\to\mathcal{R}$, let $\mathrm{SD}(\cdot,\cdot)$ denote statistical distance, and $U_\mathcal{R}$ the uniform distribution on $\mathcal{R}$. The source $S$, the predictor $P$, and the distinguisher $\mathsf{D}$ below are all computationally unbounded and receive the *entire* function table of $H$ as an explicit input.

```{=html}
<table class="cj-game-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<th>Game \(\mathsf{Pred}^{S}_{P}\)</th>
<th>Game \(\mathsf{Ext}^{S}_{\mathsf{D}}\) (secret seed)</th>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
\(H \stackrel{\$}{\leftarrow} \mathsf{Fun}(\mathcal{K}\times\mathcal{D},\mathcal{R})\)<br>
\((x,z) \stackrel{\$}{\leftarrow} S(H)\)<br>
\(x' \stackrel{\$}{\leftarrow} P(H,z)\)<br>
<b>return</b> \((x = x')\)
</td>
<td>
\(H \stackrel{\$}{\leftarrow} \mathsf{Fun}(\mathcal{K}\times\mathcal{D},\mathcal{R})\)<br>
\((x,z) \stackrel{\$}{\leftarrow} S(H)\); &nbsp; \(\mathit{sd} \stackrel{\$}{\leftarrow} \mathcal{K}\)<br>
\(y_0 \leftarrow H(\mathit{sd},x)\); &nbsp; \(y_1 \stackrel{\$}{\leftarrow} \mathcal{R}\)<br>
\(b \stackrel{\$}{\leftarrow} \{0,1\}\)<br>
\(b' \stackrel{\$}{\leftarrow} \mathsf{D}(H, y_b, z)\)<br>
<b>return</b> \((b = b')\)
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
```

Prediction game (left) and the secret-seed extraction game (right); unlike the public-seed variant (see [c/0004](/c/0004/)), $\mathsf{D}$ does not receive $\mathit{sd}$.

::: {.callout-note title="Definition (Advantages and Unpredictability)"}
Set $\mathbf{Adv}^{\mathrm{pred}}_{\mathcal{K},\mathcal{D},\mathcal{R},S}(P) := \Pr[\mathsf{Pred}^{S}_{P} \Rightarrow 1]$ and
$$
\mathbf{Adv}^{\mathrm{ext}}_{\mathcal{K},\mathcal{D},\mathcal{R}}(S,\mathsf{D}) := 2\Pr[\mathsf{Ext}^{S}_{\mathsf{D}} \Rightarrow 1] - 1 .
$$
A source $S$ is *$\epsilon$-unpredictable* if $\mathbf{Adv}^{\mathrm{pred}}_{\mathcal{K},\mathcal{D},\mathcal{R},S}(P) \le \epsilon$ for every unbounded predictor $P$.
:::

### The Conjecture

::: {.callout-important title="Conjecture (Secret seed)"}
There is a universal constant $c > 0$, independent of $\mathcal{K}$, $\mathcal{D}$, $\mathcal{R}$ and $\epsilon$, such that for all nonempty finite $\mathcal{K}, \mathcal{D}, \mathcal{R}$, all $\epsilon \in (0,1]$, every $\epsilon$-unpredictable source $S$, and every unbounded distinguisher $\mathsf{D}$,
$$
\mathbf{Adv}^{\mathrm{ext}}_{\mathcal{K},\mathcal{D},\mathcal{R}}(S,\mathsf{D})
\;\le\; \delta(\epsilon, K, D, R)
\;:=\; c \cdot \sqrt{\frac{\epsilon R + \log_2 D}{K}} \; .
$$
:::

This expression is strictly stronger than the public-seed one whenever both are compared directly (since $\sqrt{(\epsilon R + \log_2 D)/K} \le \sqrt{\epsilon R} + \sqrt{\log_2 D/K}$) -- consistent with hiding the seed only helping the extractor, never hurting it.

## Proof

## Status

Unlike its public-seed variant ([c/0004](/c/0004/), proven), no proof attempt exists here yet. The public-seed proof's technique doesn't transfer directly: once the seed is public, the distinguisher can compute the map $x \mapsto H(\mathit{sd},x)$ in full, which is exactly what makes the public-seed bound provable by the flatten-and-concentrate argument used there. With the seed secret, the distinguisher has no such foothold, and the conjectured bound is strictly stronger (see the comparison note in [c/0004](/c/0004/)'s proof), so that argument doesn't carry over as a shortcut.

A bound for this secret-seed game is referenced informally in the resolution of the public-seed case as coming from a separate "companion note" on the hidden-seed game -- that note is not included in this repository and its claim has not been independently checked, so it isn't treated as resolving this statement.

### Open obligations

- [ ] Attempt a proof of the secret-seed bound, or locate and independently verify the "companion note" mentioned in [c/0004](/c/0004/)'s proof before treating it as resolving this statement.
- [ ] Formalize the statement in Lean; not yet attempted.
